おくって.es: acompañar; enviar (forma て de おくる)
おくって.en: to be accompanied; to be sent (form)

bloques.titulo: In the case of a person who is a member of the public, he or she is a member of the public.
texto: The subject who helps is marked with the hor / hin; the previous action is in form. The perspective is that of the beneficiary, not of the agent.
(My friend accompanied me to the station.)

frases.ja: ともだち が えき まで おくって くれました。
frases.es: Mi amigo me acompañó hasta la estación.
frases.en: My friend accompanied me to the station.

frases.ja: はは が りょうり を つくって くれました。
